headline: US unveils new tariffs on China, EU and 12 others
pages: The United States on Wednesday announced a new round of tariffs on China, the European Union and 12 other trading partners. China faces the highest rate, up to 40%, followed by Vietnam at up to 35%. Others face 20% or 25%. The duties are not expected to take effect until next year, and some rates will be reduced by caps Trump has agreed to. The move follows a trade practices investigation begun in March, after the Supreme Court ruled that Trump's earlier Liberation Day tariffs were illegal. The list also includes Singapore, Switzerland, Indonesia, Malaysia, Cambodia, Thailand, Korea, Taiwan, Bangladesh, Japan and India.

Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the tariffs would level the playing field for American workers. Economists warn that tariffs can raise consumer prices if businesses pass on the costs, and can dampen global trade. Source: BBC News.
